contexts.text: The Church itself, from the affection of good, is called... virgin. AC 253.

On those who desire nothing more than to deflower virgins, and to whom virginities, and thefts of virginities are the greatest delight. (Their frightful punishment described.) SE 2704, General article. DeConj 126.
For it is the first flower of love which introduces virgins into chaste conjugial love, and conjoins the minds of the married partners.
He was born of a virgin mother, and by birth He derived infirmities from the virgin mother... AC 1428.
The speech of angelic Spirits was represented by a virgin...
Infants seen with their virgin educatresses.

The Celestial Church, being from love to the Lord in love towards the neighbour, is likened to an unmarried daughter, or virgin... as in These are they who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins... (). And that this might be represented in the Jewish Church, it was enjoined upon the priests that they should marry... virgins (; ).
Genuine conjugial love... is represented by a virgin of inexpressible beauty encompassed with a bright cloud...
There are some who are possessed by the cupidity of seducing virgins... (Their lot.)
The virgins (of Parnassus) were knowledges. AC 4966:2. AC 7729:end. ( = cognitions and scientifics of every kind). CL 182:2. DeVerbo 7:3.
(The ten) virgins = affections.
A virgin, and a man had not Known her () = pure from everything false.

A virgin, in the Word, = the Lord's Kingdom, and also the Church, and therefore everyone who is a Kingdom of the Lord, or a Church; and this from the conjugial love which is in chaste virgins. Illustrated.

In the proper sense, those are virgins who are in love to the Lord, that is, the celestial; and thus those who are in the affection of good. Those, also, are called virgins who are in charity towards the neighbour, that is, the spiritual, thus those who are in the affection of truth. Illustrated.
The term virgin is used in distinction from damsel to express innocence. Virgins are so called from conjugial love, and thus mean those who are in innocence...
A betrothed virgin = the truth of the Church about to be conjoined with good.
Virgins = the good of love to the Lord and of charity towards the neighbour; thus those who are in innocence.

(The parable of the ten virgins) = the last time of the old Church, and the first of the new... The ten virgins = all in the Church, both those in good and truth, and those in evil and falsity, (The parable Fully explained.) AC 8989:8. DSS 7. Fully explained.
The virgins whom the priests were to marry = the affection of truth.
The three virgins called the Graces = affections of good; and the virgins called Heliconidae and Parnassidae [or the Muses] = affections of truth.
The chaste virgins of the renal capsules. Described. SE 970.
A virgin = the good which is of the Celestial Church; but a girl, the truth of good, which is of the Spiritual Church. Illustrated.
Beautiful virgins () = the affection of truth. ( = those in affections of good. AC 8568.) ( = affections of truth from good. AE 386:11.)
The virgin of Israel () = the Spiritual Church.
If... a man shall persuade a virgin who is not betrothed () = good not conjoined with truth. Explained.
Those in persuasive faith... are meant by the five foolish virgins, who had no oil in their lamps.
A virgin, and a woman, in the Word, = the affection of good.
As virgins = those who are of the Church, there are so frequently mentioned in the Prophetic Word the virgin, and daughter, of Zion, of Jerusalem, and of Israel.
The images of virgins (with the Ancients) signified affections of truth.
The modest virgins (seen in a representative vision) signified affections of truth.
They who have acknowledged truths with the lips, but not with the heart, are like the foolish virgins, who had lamps but no oil...

Those not defiled with women, for they are virgins () = that they have not adulterated the truths of the Church, and defiled them with falsities of faith; but that they have loved truths because they are truths... thus from spiritual affection... The reason these are meant by virgins, is that a virgin = the Church as a bride, which wants to be conjoined with the Lord, and to become a wife; and a Church which wants to be conjoined with the Lord, loves truths because they are truths; for the conjunction is effected by means of truths when they are lived. Hence it is that Israel, Zion, and Jerusalem... are called virgins, and daughters. ( = because they are in the affection of truth for the sake of truth. AE 863.)
That all such in the Lord's Church... are meant by virgins, Illustrated.
Like affections are signified by virgins in other passages, where young men are mentioned with them, because young men = truths; and virgins, the affections of them. Illustrated.
Six virgins (seen at a wedding in Heaven).

(No men stood beside the bridegroom, because on the wedding-day the men) are numbered among the virgins... Virgins = the Church, which is of both sexes; and therefore men, as well as women, as to the Church, are virgins. Illustrated.
(The six virgins could not endure the close approach of the visitors.) Explained.
The Angel said. In Heaven we love virgins for their beauty and the grace of their manners, and we love them very much, but chastely.
When (the angelic pair) came near their Heaven, virgins came to meet them, received, and introduced them.

In Heaven there are virgins and youths, virgins of such beauty that they may be called beauties in beauty's own form... and the beauties of the virgins, and the moralities of the youths, correspond to each other... CL 355:2. CL 381.

All novitiates, on ascending into Heaven... are introduced into the company of virgins, the beauties of Heaven, who perceive from their tone of voice, speech, faces, eyes, gestures, and outpouring sphere, of what quality they are in respect to the love of the sex. Described.
Within the enclosure of the heart, and above it, the morality of a youth is deliciated with the beauty of a virgin with the deliciousnesses of the chaste love of the sex...
Love truly conjugial comes into existence when a youth sees a virgin who has been provided by the Lord, and the virgin sees the youth...
(Wives and virgins heard singing in Heaven.) Described.
Whether those who have... vowed perpetual virginity are received into Heaven, Explained.

There then arises the conjugial inclination, which is that of a virgin for a youth, and of a youth for a virgin; and, as the virgins in Heaven, equally as on earth, from innate prudence conceal their inclination to marriage, the youths there (suppose) that they affect the virgins with love...
Thus is a virgin formed into a wife. Explained.
Some of these are called... the sports of the virgins of the fountain, because virgins = the affections of knowledges; and everyone has intelligence according to his affection of knowledges.
There (then) came some virgins with pieces of embroidery and knitting, the works of their own hands, which they gave (the three strangers). And after they were gone, the virgins sang an ode...

The little boy said. Read this before these virgins of the fountain... I asked them. Why did he call you the virgins of the fountain (seeing that they were wives)? They replied, We are called virgins when we are sitting by this fountain, because we are the affections of the Truths of the wisdom of our husbands; and the affection of truth is called a virgin.
In the virgins (of Heaven) there is only the brightness-of beauty; but in the wives its splendour.
Provided (the pellicacy) is not with a virgin...

For, with women, conjugial love acts as a one with their virginity... and therefore to solemnly promise and surrender that virginity to any man, is to give a pledge that she will love him to eternity; and therefore a virgin cannot bargain it away with any rational consent, except with the solemn promise of the conjugial covenant. It is also the crown of her honour. Therefore, to take it from her without the covenant of marriage, and then discard her, is to make a harlot of some virgin who might have become a bride and a chaste wife, or to defraud some other man... Therefore he who joins to him a virgin as a mistress, may indeed cohabit with her, and thus initiate her into the friendship of love; but with the constant intention... that she shall become his wife.
Virgins, who were beauties, because images of heavenly affection, were brought to (the novitiate Spirit)... but on seeing them he returned into his internals, and... they vanished. Explained.
On the state of a virgin... before marriage, and after it. Explained.
That virginity is the crown of chastity, and the pledge of conjugial love. Explained.
Some adulterers are possessed with the desire of deflowering virgins...
When (their) potency has failed, they boast of the number of virginities...
If (such marry) they have nothing in mind but the virginity of their future consort; and, when they have sipped this, they loathe both bed and chamber.
The first state (of regeneration) is represented by... that of every virgin before she becomes a wife.
Those who only understand and speak truths and goods, are like the foolish virgins... But those who also will and do them, are the prudent virgins...
On whoremongers who with deceit allure virgins to whoredom.
On those who are possessed with a cupidity for virginities. General article.
A (representative) virgin seen. Described.
Such are represented, also, by a bright virgin...
Spirits who, in life, had burned for the innocent, such as chaste virgins. Described.
A tranquil combat of the virgin sex against the evil. Explained.
Those who have ruined virgins... are sent into such cities. Ties.
Daughters and virgins as seen in the Celestial Kingdom. Described.
The virgins are admonished by changes of beauty in their faces.
On some virgins who read daily in the Word. Described.
How virgins are brought up in the other life, and in Heaven. General article.
These are like the live (foolish) virgins...
Virgins who have imbued piety to the extent of becoming somewhat melancholy, make sad wives, and cannot be among the happy in Heaven... Thus [is it] with those who have lived in nunneries.
In a dream, I saw a virgin in a room... She appeared like an angelic virgin; (but) she communicated with Societies of adultery. (She represented the [selfish] love of friendship.)

The ten virgins = all who are of the Church; five = some of them... The five wise virgins = those who are in love and the derivative faith; and the five foolish virgins = those who are in no love, but in faith alone. AE 212:4. AE 250:7. AE 252:8, Fully Explained. AE 375:41. AE 548:3. AE 675:6. AE 840:3. AE 860.
The virgin of Israel = the Church. AE 555:4. ( = the Church from the affection of truth. AE 863:12.)
Virgins = the affection of truth and good. AE 270:5. AE 315:7. AE 637:11.
Virgins = the spiritual affection of truth.
Young men = truths; virgins, goods. AE 721:3.
Young men = affections of truth; virgins, affections of good.
The virgins in the cities of Judah () = affections of truth from the good of love.
A virgin = the affection of truth.

Virgins = those affections of truth which are called spiritual affections of truth. Explained... Those in these affections love truths because they are truths... and those who love truths in this way, love the Lord; because the Lord is in man in the truths which are from good...

The reason those in the spiritual affection of truth are called virgins, is based on the marriage of good and truth, from which comes conjugial love... for as virgins love to be conjoined with men who have the understanding of truth = they = the affections of truth. Fully illustrated.
Young man, and virgin () = the understanding and the affection of what is false.

As the Church is the Church from the spiritual affection of truth... the expressions virgin of Israel, the virgin daughter of Zion, the virgin daughter of My people, the virgin daughter of Zidon, the virgin daughter of Egypt, and also the virgin daughter of Babylon, are frequently used in the Word.
Thus virginity = the inviolate affection of truth. II!.
There are excrementitious Hells for those whose delights have been debauchings of virgins.

Virgins (seen there) who had accounted whoredoms wicked because contrary to the Divine law; and also virgins who had not accounted them wicked, but still had abstained from them on account of the disrepute, which would repel suitors. These latter virgins I have seen encompassed with a dusky cloud in their descent to the lower regions; and the former with a bright light in their ascent to the higher regions.
Every Church at its beginning is like a virgin; but in process of time it becomes a harlot. Explained.
Approach ten maidens in order to choose one for a wife; and will you not first examine their quality...
The virgin, from whom He was born, = the Church as to the affection of truth.
It was necessary for Him to be born from a virgin in lawful marriage with Joseph.
